notes.title: Major optimization of game operation and play
notes.content:
After unremitting efforts, "wisdom of war" has finally ushered in an epic major update, greatly optimized the operation of the game, and added new content, including:

1. Shortcut keys are added to each operation.

2. The right mouse button can command the hero to go to the destination, including going to the building and collecting resources. After collecting resources, the hero will automatically return to the warehouse.

3. Place the mouse on the edge of the map to scroll the map.

4. The perspective is no longer only hero centered, but can be changed at will. Press the space bar to quickly switch the perspective back to hero centered.

5. Instead of just clicking to select a company, you can select multiple companies from the box.

6. A quick navigation panel is added, which can command the hero to go to a building or collect some resources without changing the lens.

7. When the hero reaches the control point of the building, the function options of the control point can be displayed directly, which simplifies the operation.

8. A new challenge mode is added to speed up the rhythm of the game and increase the challenge and interest of the game.

notes.title: A new update released.
notes.content:
1. Now you can move map in non-suspended state by pressing W,S,A,D key while holding Shift key.

2. Resource harvesting efficiency has been greatly improved and tempo of the fight also has been markedly accelerated.

1. 现在可以在非暂停状态下，在按住Shift键的同时按W、S、A、D键移动地图。

2. 资源的采集效率显著提高，战斗节奏也明显加快。
